subject: Federation prospect form - I want it by COB tomorrow
snippet: Lamar, federation window closes Monday. Let's have your three rows reviewed by EOD Tue.
body:
Lamar,

Federation submission window closes Monday Feb 1. I want your three prospect rows reviewed, evaluations attached and the v1.2 form ready in the SHF pathway folder by COB tomorrow. We can talk through Oskar's row Wednesday morning.

Camp 2027 budget proposal is still due Feb 20 - don't lose sight of it.

Mikael

subject: SHF Pathway Circular v1.2 - February prospect submission
snippet: Circular v1.2 issued Jan 19. Submission window closes Feb 1 23:59 CET. Acknowledgement required.
body:
Hej tranar,

Circular v1.2 has been published to the SHF confidential pathway folder. Submission window closes Feb 1 23:59 CET. Acknowledgement of receipt is required before submission is accepted; see footnote on page 4 for the per-club ceiling on entries.

Form v1.2 has been pre-filled with your club's metadata. Please complete prospect rows 1-3 and re-upload as PDF.

Varliga halsningar,
SHF Pathway Office

subject: Norrlandsposten - mid-season feature on Bjorkleden J20
snippet: Want to do a long-form piece. Need 15 min with you. Off-record OK, no surprises.
body:
Lamar -

Pitching a long-form to my editor on Bjorkleden's J20 playoff push. I'd want tactical context and grading by line - I'll keep it cleanly attributed. 15 minutes by phone is enough, Thursday or Friday this week works on my end.

No surprises, off-record where you need it.

Frida
(skickat fran iPhone)

subject: Ater igang - kan ringa pa onsdag
snippet: Hofta laker bra. Glad att hora ifran dig nar du orkar. Onsdag kl 19 funkar.
body:
Lamar pojken,

Hoftan lakte bra till sist - jag tackar narsystern och en envis sjukgymnast. Tre forlorade samtal i hostas, men jag forstar att hostsasongen ar hostsasongen.

Nar du har en stund - onsdag kvall klockan 19 funkar fint for mig. Vi pratar om dina tre, om Mikael, och om varfor du fortfarande inte har skickat in coachdiplom-papperen.

Kram fran gamla tranaren,
Tommy

subject: Morgonskate-anteckning - Oskar
snippet: Han laggar pa hoger sida igen i overgangarna. Vill du jag tar honom i sidan efter passet?
body:
Lamar,

Vi sag det igen pa morgonskaten - Oskar laggar tydligt pa hoger sida i overgangsfasen, framforallt nar han hamtar puck under press. Inget panikartat men vi vill flagga det innan Brynas pa lordag. Vill du jag pratar med honom efter passet eller vantar vi tills du har sett klippet?

Nils
